sys_script.description: Rejects a sales order line save when the incremental dispatched_quantity delta exceeds the finished-goods ledger balance. Order 160 so it runs after Validate Dispatch Quantity (100, dispatched must not exceed ordered) and after SnackFlow Sales Line Calc (150). Because this is a BEFORE rule it aborts the line save itself, so neither the line nor the stock ledger is written. This replaces the previous behaviour where the line saved successfully and only the ledger insert was refused by SnackFlow Stock Negative Check, leaving the sales line and the stock ledger inconsistent with the discrepancy reported only through gs.error.
sys_script.name: SnackFlow Dispatch Stock Guard
